title: channel.py:58: ZeroDivisionError when superframe_duration_us is 0
description: sfn_from_unix_time() divides by superframe_duration_us without checking for zero. GnssHopConfig allows this field to be set to any int, and there is no validation preventing 0. This causes ZeroDivisionError. Fix: Add validation if superframe_duration_us <= 0: return 0 or raise ValueError at config creation time.
close_reason: Bug already fixed: sfn_from_unix_time() guards against superframe_duration_us <= 0 at line 57. No code changes needed.
